report_notes: Full October 5 rerun of all ten runtimes on PHP 8.5.11, with FrankenPHP 1.13.0, FreeUnit 1.37.0, and opcache.enable_file_override=1.
Unrelated development containers were running on the host during the measurements.
All three Rapira modes recorded socket read errors on both endpoints. Raw wrkx logs retain the per-stage counts; the Rapira worker application log was empty when sampled.

OxPHP worker database errors began at the 30,000 RPS target. From 40,000 RPS onward, all responses in each stage were errors. Application and PostgreSQL log samples show connections rejected with "too many clients already". These failures are included in the charts and tables.
